key: How is anyone supposed to find their way out of this place?!
en: How is anyone supposed to find their way out of this place?!
ja: こんな場所から、一体どうやって抜け出せばいいのよ?!

key: Oh forget it all, just burn!
en: Oh forget it all, just burn!
ja: アウレリア: もう知らない、燃やしちゃえ!

key: It had to be done.
en: It had to be done.
ja: こうするしかなかったの。

key: Are you perhaps having some trouble?
en: Are you perhaps having some trouble?
ja: もしかして、お困りですか?

key: All you have to do is keep going.
en: All you have to do is keep going.
ja: セラティサ: 進み続けるだけでいいんですよ。

key: Many people get lost here, but it really isn't all that confusing, you know?
en: Many people get lost here, but it really isn't all that confusing, you know?
ja: ここで迷う人は多いですけど、実際はそんなに複雑じゃないんです。

key: Sure, it'll take you in circles...
en: Sure, it'll take you in circles...
ja: たしかに、ぐるぐる回らされますけど……

key: But there's only ever one path at a time.
en: But there's only ever one path at a time.
ja: でも、進める道は常にひとつだけです。

key: All you have to do is keep moving forward, even if it feels like you're going backwards.
en: All you have to do is keep moving forward, even if it feels like you're going backwards.
ja: 後退しているように感じても、前に進み続けるだけでいいんです。

key: Progress is like that, sometimes.
en: Progress is like that, sometimes.
ja: 前進って、時々そういうものですから。

key: RESEARCHER: Oh, hello there! I'm surprised to see someone else so deep in these woods!
en: RESEARCHER: Oh, hello there! I'm surprised to see someone else so deep in these woods!
ja: 研究者: おや、こんにちは! こんな森の奥で、他の人に会えるとは驚きました!

key: I'm with the Aventurine Nature Center. We've been conducting various research on all sorts of environments, both local and distant.
en: I'm with the Aventurine Nature Center. We've been conducting various research on all sorts of environments, both local and distant.
ja: わたしはアベンチュリン自然センターの者です。この地域や遠方の、あらゆる環境について様々な調査を行っています。

key: I was just setting up a Field Effect extraction point here.
en: I was just setting up a Field Effect extraction point here.
ja: ちょうど、フィールド効果の抽出ポイントをここに設置していたところです。

key: We often do this in remote areas where we can get the purest readings on the effect nature has on it!
en: We often do this in remote areas where we can get the purest readings on the effect nature has on it!
ja: 自然の影響を最も純粋な形で測定できる、こういうへんぴな場所でよくやるんですよ!

key: It takes quite a while, and sometimes data pieces get left behind, so please feel free to take any Field data you find laying about!
en: It takes quite a while, and sometimes data pieces get left behind, so please feel free to take any Field data you find laying about!
ja: かなり時間がかかるので、データの断片が置き去りになることもあります。落ちているフィールドデータがあれば、ご自由にお持ちください!

key: This one won't be ready for quite some time, but since you came all the way out here, let me give you data from an earlier extraction.
en: This one won't be ready for quite some time, but since you came all the way out here, let me give you data from an earlier extraction.
ja: これはまだしばらく準備が整いませんが、せっかくここまで来ていただいたので、以前の抽出データをお渡ししましょう。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 02!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 02!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書02を手に入れた!

key: Info on Grassy Terrain now available!
en: Info on Grassy Terrain now available!
ja: グラスフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: RESEARCHER: Please make good use of it in your journey!
en: RESEARCHER: Please make good use of it in your journey!
ja: 研究者: 旅の中で、ぜひ役立ててください!

key: RESEARCHER: Nature's effect is truly stunning!
en: RESEARCHER: Nature's effect is truly stunning!
ja: 研究者: 自然の影響というのは、本当に驚くべきものです!

key: But why does it seem more vibrant here in Reborn than in other regions?
en: But why does it seem more vibrant here in Reborn than in other regions?
ja: でも、どうしてリボーンでは他の地方よりも、それが鮮やかに感じられるんでしょうね?

key: Someday, I hope to discover an answer to that.
en: Someday, I hope to discover an answer to that.
ja: いつか、その答えを見つけたいと思っています。

key: A traveler? Let's see if you're fit to continue your journey!
en: A traveler? Let's see if you're fit to continue your journey!
ja: 旅人か? 旅を続けるにふさわしいか、見せてもらおうか!

key: Guess I have to train more too.
en: Guess I have to train more too.
ja: エリザベス: あたしも、もっと鍛えないとね。

key: You be careful around here, okay?
en: You be careful around here, okay?
ja: この辺りには、気をつけてね?

key: Ugh... I feel like I'm just going in circles.
en: Ugh... I feel like I'm just going in circles.
ja: うう……ずっと同じところをぐるぐる回ってる気がする。

key: Futile.
en: Futile.
ja: クリスチャン: 無駄だ。

key: This place is horridly confusing.
en: This place is horridly confusing.
ja: この場所は、恐ろしく紛らわしい。

key: A Pokémon jumped out of the fountain!
en: A Pokémon jumped out of the fountain!
ja: ポケモンが噴水から飛び出した!

key: Wh-where am I?
en: Wh-where am I?
ja: こ、ここはどこ?

key: I was just sitting in front of the Center, and then all of a sudden I fell out of the air and landed here!
en: I was just sitting in front of the Center, and then all of a sudden I fell out of the air and landed here!
ja: センターの前に座ってただけなのに、突然空から落ちてきて、ここに着地したの!

key: But I landed on my leg, and I don't think I can move...
en: But I landed on my leg, and I don't think I can move...
ja: でも、脚から着地しちゃって、動けそうにない……

key: Could you do me the biggest favor and get some Herbal Extract from the PokéMart in town?
en: Could you do me the biggest favor and get some Herbal Extract from the PokéMart in town?
ja: すっごく大きなお願いなんだけど、町のポケモンショップでやくそうエキスを取ってきてくれない?

key: I'm sure it'll heal my leg right up.
en: I'm sure it'll heal my leg right up.
ja: きっと、脚がすぐ治ると思うから。

key: Until then, I don't think I can-- ow!-- move...
en: Until then, I don't think I can-- ow!-- move...
ja: それまでは……いたっ!……動けそうにない……

key: That's the Herbal Extract!
en: That's the Herbal Extract!
ja: それ、やくそうエキスだね!

key: Can I have it?
en: Can I have it?
ja: もらってもいい?

key: \PN handed over the Herbal Extract.
en: \PN handed over the Herbal Extract.
ja: \PNはやくそうエキスを手渡した。

key: Thank you! I feel much better now.
en: Thank you! I feel much better now.
ja: ありがとう! だいぶ楽になった。

key: That was so scary!
en: That was so scary!
ja: すごく怖かった!

key: Here, I'd like you to have this.
en: Here, I'd like you to have this.
ja: はい、これ、受け取って。

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Chansey!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Chansey!
ja: \PNはデパートシール「ラッキー」を手に入れた!

key: I'm going to head back into town now, but thank you once again for saving me!
en: I'm going to head back into town now, but thank you once again for saving me!
ja: もう町に戻るけど、助けてくれて本当にありがとう!

key: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card from the Department Store in the city? That's no good.
en: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card from the Department Store in the city? That's no good.
ja: あら、街のデパートのメンバーズカード、持ってないの? それはダメだね。

key: Well, if you get one, come back to me and I'll give you a Sticker for it!
en: Well, if you get one, come back to me and I'll give you a Sticker for it!
ja: まあ、手に入れたら、また戻ってきて。シールをあげるから!

key: I'm going to head back into town now, but find me later!
en: I'm going to head back into town now, but find me later!
ja: もう町に戻るけど、また会いに来てね!

key: But, then what will I do?
en: But, then what will I do?
ja: でも、それじゃ、あたしどうしよう?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
